keyPages.summary: Start a visual science exploration with fractals, image complexity measurement, evidence comparison, and reproducible context.
Explore interactive Mandelbrot, Julia, Burning Ship, Newton, Barnsley Fern, and Sierpinski fractals.
Browse curated learning challenges and shared visual-science examples.
Find and explain repeated structure across scale in a guided fractal challenge.
Build a clear, evidence-led comparison between two visual artifacts.
Practice a reproducible ROI-based box-counting workflow and export a method record.
Practice cautious, non-diagnostic interpretation of an AI image overlay.
Estimate image-region fractal dimension with visible box counts and fit-quality checks.
Compare matched images with consistent settings and a careful evidence summary.
Explore a clearly scoped educational prototype for AI localization and complementary fractal-morphology research.
